visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a dark stone exterior wall featuring the InterContinental Taichung logo in gold lettering, partially obscured by lush green bushes under bright natural sunlight. (2) The camera tilts upwards towards a clear blue sky, showing the sun's rays glinting off a modern high-rise building with a glass facade, framed by the green leaves of tall trees. (3) Inside a hotel lobby, an intricate and large chandelier made of dozens of translucent glass rods hangs from the ceiling, emitting a warm, golden glow in a spacious, well-lit environment. (4) A hand with light skin tones gestures towards a king-sized bed with white, slightly rumpled linens in a guest room decorated with neutral tones and modern furniture; a large window provides ample daylight. (5) Mechanical blinds roll up automatically to reveal a bright city view, followed by a close-up of fluted glass pendant lights that cast a soft, warm light against a dark background. (6) In a modern grey-tiled bathroom, a rain shower head sprays water, and a man in a black graphic t-shirt holds a Dyson hairdryer while looking into a large mirror with a surprised facial expression. (7) A white oval soaking tub is positioned next to a large floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the city; a wooden bath tray rests across the tub's rim in a clean, brightly lit setting. (8) At a high-end restaurant, a group of guests is seated around a white marble table; a young woman with dark hair wears a pink shirt and eats a piece of steak with a fork. (9) The scene transitions to a gym with silver exercise machines, followed by an outdoor infinity pool with clear blue water and tropical trees in the background. (10) Red and white plumeria flowers are shown resting on a grey stone textured ground near the pool area, creating a calm and luxury atmosphere. (11) A wide shot shows the modern glass facade of the hotel rising from the street level; outside, two women walk together under a black umbrella, smiling at the camera. (12) Inside a vehicle, a woman with blonde-dyed hair takes a large bite out of a bagel wrapped in paper; then, a sign for a traditional noodle shop with a black-and-white drawing is shown. (13) In the hotel lobby, three women in casual and stylish clothing talk and laugh together near a marble counter under soft, ambient lighting. (14) A close-up shows a hand holding a wooden room key card with the hotel's logo and brand name engraved on it against a paper card holder.
